title: Web Summit's pre-tax profits slump in 2022 (RTE, 16 February 2024)
what_it_says: RTE reports Web Summit's 2022 accounts: revenues of 52.5m euro, pre-tax profit of 326,484 euro, and the company's own figures for the sold-out 2022 Lisbon event (71,000 attendees, 2,300 startups, 342 partners, 160 countries).
